dedupe_keys.name: cycling facilities in ile de france from the ile de france mobilites inventory as re published on local open data portals

description: Cycling facilities in Île-de-France from the Île-de-France Mobilités inventory, as re-published on local open data portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 10 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 11 datasets on 10 portals hold the regional inventory of cycle paths and cycling facilities of Île-de-France, as re-published or filtered to a local area. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Cesson, Combs-la-Ville, Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne), Lisses). The copies sit on: data.combs-la-ville.fr, data.etiolles.fr, data.grandparissud.fr, data.mairie-ris-orangis.fr, data.moissy-cramayel.fr, data.saint-pierre-du-perray.fr, data.ville-cesson.fr, lisses-grandparissud.opendatasoft.com and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl), ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
